title: add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs quickstarts
author: Ava Kim
description:
Motivation: provide copy-pasteable RAG agent templates and tool-calling examples to reduce onboarding time for developers integrating retrieval-augmented generation and agent-style workflows. This PR adds curated quickstarts (Python/TS), a set of RAG agent templates (retrieval + tool-calling orchestrations), and corresponding docs site pages and examples.

What changed (high level): added RAG agent templates with configuration and testing harness, added two tool-calling examples (calendar-search and code-executor shim), expanded the docs quickstarts with step-by-step guides and runnable snippets, and updated sidebar navigation and example manifests.

Checklist:
- [x] Add RAG agent templates and test harness
- [x] Add Python and TypeScript quickstarts and run locally
- [x] Update docs site pages and sidebar entries
- [x] Validate CI (lint/docs build) and fix warnings
- [x] Add changelog/release notes entry

Notes: templates are intentionally opinionated: they wire retrieval -> prompt templates -> tool-calling fallback flow and include eval hooks for quality monitoring. Examples demonstrate both the hosted API pattern and local agent runtime configuration for private deployments. The docs include minimal credentials and mock K/V steps to keep examples runnable in CI.

Related: ENG-3421 (RAG quickstarts), PM-187 (Developer onboarding improvements).
